He appears on the second floor and says that Ghetsis intends to test the {{player}}. He later appears with all the other sages (except [[Ghetsis]]) at [[N's Castle]], blocking the player's way to [[N]]. However, he is stopped by the [[Unova]] [[Gym Leader]]s who clear a path for the player to N. After Ghetsis has been defeated, Ryoku can be found in the Relic Castle, attempting to catch the {{p|Volcarona}} that resides there to impress Ghetsis. When found, he gives the player {{TM|04|Calm Mind}} and is arrested by [[Looker]]. Ryoku does not make an appearance in {{B2W2}}. ===Quotes=== ====Pokémon Black and White==== '''Relic Castle''' :''"Ghetsis told us that once again we should test how much power you have. We will see if you can defeat Team Plasma!"'' :''"Go! Hurry and fall through the flowing sands!"'' '''N's Castle''' :''"One can lose the forest for the trees."'' :''"We can only do our best and leave the rest to fate. We've done everything in our power. All we can do now is believe in our lord N...and wait."'' '''Relic Castle''' :''"I was planning to catch the Pokémon called {{p|Volcarona}} that lives in this Relic Castle and present it to Ghetsis. {{color2|000|Generation V}} |} ==In animation== [[File:Ryoku PG.png|thumb|250px|Ryoku in [[Pokémon Generations]]]] ===Pokémon Generations=== Ryoku appeared in ''[[PG13|The Uprising]]''. He was shown at [[N's Castle]] as it was rising from the ground and surrounding the {{un|Pokémon League}}. ====Voice actors==== {{vatable|color={{green color}}|bordercolor={{green color light}} |ja=岡部涼音 ''Suzune Okabe'' |en=Patrick Seitz |es_eu=Ángel del Río}} ==In the manga== [[File:Ryoku Giallo Zinzolin Adventures.png|thumb|200px|Ryoku in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== Ryoku appears as a member of the Seven Sages in the {{MangaArc|Black & White}}. Three years prior to the start of the chapter, he is tasked with finding the Sun Pokémon {{p|Volcarona}} and protecting it from humans. Ryoku first appears alongside the other Sages in ''[[PS467|Letting Go]]'' walking with Ghetsis after the latter gave a speech on releasing Pokémon to the public. In ''[[PS482|To Make a Musical]]'', Ryoku was shown in front of the [[Relic Castle]] with a [[Rage Candy Bar|RageCandyBar]] in hand, where he was waiting for his Grunts to reunite so that they could enter Relic Castle. As the Grunt he was waiting for had been defeated by [[Grimsley]], Ryoku had no choice but to go inside with the group he already had. He manages to succeed in obtaining Volcarona for Ghetsis, and the Egg it produced was given to one of the [[Shadow Triad]]. After {{adv|N}} awakens Zekrom from the [[Dark Stone]], Ryoku and the other sages watch as N attempts to befriend Zekrom and have it join Team Plasma's cause. At the {{OBP|Pokémon League|Unova}}, Team Plasma enacts its plan and summons N's Castle from the depths of the earth to surround the League building. Ryoku and the other Sages emerge from the castle as they watch the chaos unfold. {{adv|Black}} attempts to confront them, but Ghetsis easily defeats Black's team. With no way to save the Gym Leaders, stop the Grunts causing havoc below, and face N in battle, Black is assisted by several Trainers that he had met over the course of his journey. The Trainers battle against the sages and rescue the Gym Leaders from the bindings. The Gym Leaders then help battle the sages, but Ryoku and the others eventually escape from the battle without being seen. In the {{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}, Ryoku and the other Seven Sages were sought after by [[International Police]] members {{adv|Blake}} and {{adv|Looker}}, who aimed to arrest them along with the other remaining Team Plasma members. Ryoku was reported to have been seen alongside Bronius in the [[Castelia Sewers]]. Blake, {{adv|Whitley}}, [[Hugh]], and [[Roxie]] travel to the sewers after discovering a man that had his Pokémon stolen by Team Plasma. After investigating the area, Blake and his friends are attacked by a group of Team Plasma Grunts, forcing the group to scatter. While the others battle Grunts, Blake effortlessly arrests Ryoku and Bronius. Despite being captured, Ryoku and Bronius are confident, as the entire incident was nothing more than a diversion. A chill begins to fill the area, which Ryoku and Bronius reveal means their leader achieved his goal. ====Pokémon==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Ryoku |pkmn=Scolipede |gender=male |type1=Bug |type2=Poison |img=Ryoku Scolipede Adventures.png |epnum=PS521 |epname=Triple Threat |desc={{p|Scolipede}} was used at the {{OBP|Pokémon League|Unova}} to combat the Trainers helping Black rescue the kidnapped Gym Leaders. When the Gym Leaders were freed, Scolipede was left to fight alone with the other sages' Pokémon after the Seven Sages escaped. None of Scolipede's moves are known.}} ==Trivia== * In Black and White, Ryoku quotes lines from Chinese classical text: ** ''"One can lose the forest for the trees."'' is unrelated to the original line in Japanese'''リョクシ'''：一を知りて　二を知らず ({{game|Black and White|s}}, Japanese) which refers to the quote 識其一，不知其二 (to know the first but not the second) in the book of ''{{wp|Zhuangzi (book)|Zhuangzi}}'', an ancient text that serves as a foundational text in {{wp|Taoism}}. ** ''"We can only do our best and leave the rest to fate."'''''リョクシ'''：人事を尽くして天命を待つ ({{game|Black and White|s}}, Japanese) refers to the quote 盡人事而待天命 in ''Readings in History'' (讀史管見) by {{wp|Song Dynasty}} philosopher Hu Yin (胡寅). ==Names== {| class="roundtable" style="background:#{{green color}}; border:3px solid #{{green color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{green color light}}" | Language ! style="background:#{{green color light}}" | Name ! style="background:#{{green color light}}" | Origin |- | Japanese | リョクシ ''Ryokushi'' | From 緑色 ''ryokushoku'' (green)[https://twitter.com/matsumiyan/status/284308082543173632 Tweet by Toshinobu Matsumiya マツミや (@matsumiyan).
